The Company

Asia Football Group (AFG) is the exclusive commercial agency for the Asian Football Confederation’s (AFC) competitions from 2023-2028. Our partnership with the AFC covers the commercial rights for all major AFC National Team and Club competitions, including the AFC Asian Cup, AFC Asian Qualifiers, AFC Women’s Asian Cup, AFC Women’s Olympic Qualifiers, AFC Champions League, AFC Cup as well as AFC youth and futsal competitions.

Driven by a shared passion and dedication to Asian football, our industry experts have a wealth of experience in global, regional, and local football marketing, and are devoted to delivering exciting and engaging Asian football content to fans on ground, on screen, and online. Working closely with the AFC and its stakeholders, Asia Football Group strives for the success and growth of Asian football, as well as redefining Asian football’s commercial standing within global football by addressing the shared business objectives of the AFC, its sponsors and media partners with solutions derived from optimising fan engagement and digitally driven innovations.

The Role

Creatively ambitious content creator with strong technical video editing, graphic design or motion graphic skills keen to push the envelope and elevate our content to the top level. Comprehensive experience producing high-volume of AV assets, both short and long form, to tight deadlines with competing priorities without compromising quality. A professional who turns creative ideas and concepts into powerful content that captivates audiences. Strong knowledge of AV content that works for social media (Meta platforms, X, TikTok/Douyin, YouTube, Weibo). Responsible for production and the timely delivery of all AV assets required for global campaigns and sponsorship activations.

Key Responsibilities

Develop innovative creative concepts for campaigns and content.
Source, edit, and manage assets from various sources.
Create eye-catching motion graphics and graphics to elevate video storytelling.
Edit and refine video content, including adding sound effects, music, and transitions.
Collaborate with the AVP Creative Production, Content Producer and other team members to brainstorm and execute engaging video strategies.
Ensure projects are delivered on time and meet the highest quality standards.

Skills, Experience and Qualifications

Highly motivated and creative individual with a strong eye for detail.
Proven track record of delivering high-quality video editing, motion graphics, and/or graphic design work while meeting tight deadlines.
Expertise in content creation software like Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, with advanced skills in Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
Ability to create engaging motion graphics to elevate video content.
Experience working with sports content (match footage, highlights, sponsor activations) is ideal.
Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration with internal teams.

Fluent English and/or Arabic speaker.

Interested parties, please apply with your application letter, resume, current and expected salary, and availability by clicking "Apply."

Deadline for application:

Applicants not invited for interviews within six weeks may consider their applications unsuccessful. Personal data collected will be treated strictly confidential and be used for the purpose of recruitment only. All collected information will be kept on our files for 12 months.

Overview

Consilio builds eDiscovery and legal technology solutions used by legal teams at major organizations. Our users make consequential decisions inside our products — often under deadline, always under scrutiny. And the language in those interfaces is how they understand what the system did, what it's asking of them, and what happens next.

We're hiring our first dedicated content strategist to own that layer across a portfolio of enterprise products. You'll sit at the intersection of language, product strategy, system logic, and emerging technology, and you'll be the authority on what we call things and how we explain them.

You'd join a User Experience team built deliberately as a strategic function — design, research, content, and design systems together. The problems are unglamorous in the best way: dense workflows, real consequences, users who notice when language is imprecise.

How this role operates

This is not a copywriting role or an embedded-writer role. Instead of writing every string yourself, you'll build the infrastructure that lets other people write well without you: terminology systems, voice & tone, content patterns, and guardrails that keep AI-assisted drafting on-voice. You'll own the logic, taxonomy, and rationale behind our hardest content problems and scale that intent across products and teams.

Expect to oscillate. Some weeks you'll be deeply embedded in a single high-leverage initiative. Others you'll operate consultatively across several product teams at once, setting direction and auditing what ships. Both modes require you to be persuasive without formal authority.

Responsibilities

• Content systems and governance.Build, govern, and maintain our voice & tone, terminology standards, and content pattern libraries that span our portfolio. And drive their adoption across internal and partner teams.• Content strategy for AI-assisted experiences.Our products increasingly incorporate AI-driven capabilities. Lead how our products explain what AI did, how confident it is, and where human judgment is required.• Strategic content architecture.Drive complex initiatives from problem framing forward, owning content structure, hierarchy, and flow including onboarding and in-product guidance alongside design and product.• Audit, gap analysis, and roadmap.Assess content quality across products, define the target state, and own the plan to close the gap..• Design system partnership. Own the content layer of our design system — voice and tone, UI terminology, taxonomy, content components and patterns — documented for others to use independently.• Enablement and practice maturation. Upskill product designers, PMs, and partner teams through documentation, workshops, and review mechanisms.• Quality assurance across the journey. Serve as the standing check on narrative coherence across live experiences, so that teams building in parallel don't fragment the customer journey.

Qualifications

• 10+ years in content strategy or content design• At least 4 years building, governing, or contributing to content systems, terminology standards, or design system content layers across multiple products• Experience designing content for AI-driven features, or a clear, well-reasoned point of view on how to• Demonstrated experience influencing product and content direction without formal authority• Fluency in Figma and a working understanding of how content maps to components and tokens• Strong presentation skills, with the ability to build a persuasive narrative for executive audiences Qualities we're looking for• Undaunted by domain complexity — you'll learn a specialized professional field deeply enough to debate its vocabulary with practitioners, and you'll find that energizing rather than tedious• A systems thinker who treats terminology and content patterns as infrastructure with dependencies and maintenance costs• Comfortable making a decision and defending it.• Extreme attention to detail alongside genuine tolerance for ambiguity and unfinished ground Portfolio• A strong portfolio demonstrating complex content strategy across multiple web-based enterprise products, showing the reasoning behind the words and not just the words

Consilio’s True North Values

  • Client Experience | Listen for the “why”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
  • Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geography, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
  • Innovation | Always be curious (ABC). Challenge the status quo. Experiment and fail forward. Build for the future.

As a Senior Content Designer at Fueled, you’ll bring clarity to complex product experiences through thoughtful, strategic content design. You’ll partner closely with design, product, and engineering teams to shape content systems that scale by moving beyond copy to define structure, meaning, and user understanding across digital products.

Intentionally remote, our team thrives in a culture that values flexibility, creativity, and cutting-edge technology. Together, we’re shaping the future of digital experiences.

What you will do:

  • Lead content design across client engagements, shaping clear, user-centered experiences through content strategy, UX writing, and information architecture.
  • Translate ambiguous product and business goals into structured content models, messaging frameworks, and scalable content systems.
  • Write and adapt content to meet client needs, balancing brand voice, user experience, and business objectives.
  • Collaborate with product designers, engineers, and stakeholders to integrate content seamlessly into the product development process.
  • Define and deliver key content artifacts (e.g., audits, taxonomies, content models, voice and tone guidelines) while facilitating workshops to align teams on strategy and direction.

What you will achieve:

  • Deliver content systems and experiences that improve clarity, usability, and overall product effectiveness.
  • Create scalable content foundations that support long-term product growth and consistency across platforms.
  • Help teams move from ambiguity to clarity by structuring content in ways that enable confident design and engineering decisions.
  • Strengthen collaboration across disciplines by integrating content design into product thinking from the start.
  • Raise the bar for content design craft across projects, contributing to thoughtful, strategic, and user-centered outcomes.

About you:

  • You have 4+ years in content design, UX writing, or content strategy, ideally within an agency environment.
  • You thrive in fast-paced, multi-client settings and are comfortable navigating ambiguity.
  • You bring a strategic approach to content, with experience in content modeling, IA, and structured content.
  • You are experienced working with CMS platforms, shaping how content is structured and managed.
  • You are a strong collaborator and communicator, able to align teams and clearly articulate content decisions to clients and stakeholders.

Contractor Fee

Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, projects, geographic location, and business needs.

Join our Contractor Pool

This role is designed as a contract position, offering you the opportunity to experience our team and culture while showcasing your contributions. When the fit and business needs align, some contractors are invited to explore a transition into full-time roles.

If you are passionate about Fueled’s mission and think you have what it takes to be successful in this role, please apply. We’d appreciate the opportunity to review your application. Everyone gets a response.

Upon meeting the necessary criteria, you’ll join the Fueled contractor network, granting you access to project invitations tailored to your expertise and availability when they arise.

Any data provided will be processed in accordance with applicable law and our privacy policy. Curious about what to expect during our talent process? Check it out here.

We don't want you to miss any communication from us! To ensure you receive updates on your application, please add to your contacts list!

About Ethos

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the role

Design at Ethos plays an instrumental role in shaping every aspect of the product. We work across the organization to develop novel solutions to large, interesting challenges, and build world-class products that create real value for real people. You will invent, experiment (and occasionally fail), and most importantly, you will make an impact and grow in your craft.

We're looking for a Staff Content Designer to craft content, messaging, and story across our consumer experience, and to help contribute to how Content Design works at Ethos as we scale.

This role is significantly hands-on. You'll craft the language that turns a complex, high-stakes financial decision into something clear, trustworthy and motivating, and you'll contribute to the standards and practices that help content design grow as a discipline here. You'll partner daily with Product, Product Design, Research, and Analytics, and you'll be involved from the earliest ideation conversations.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Own narrative, copywriting, and craft

  • Write and shape content across the purchase journey, including landing pages, onboarding, checkout, post-purchase, and the microcopy that quietly builds or breaks trust
  • Build the narrative backbone for major product flows so that every touchpoint feels like part of one story
  • Balance functional clarity with emotional resonance, demystifying a complex product while motivating someone through a difficult and sometimes daunting process
  • Rapidly iterate on content in a collaborative setting, being able to clearly articulate what the goals are, what works well, and why
  • Present your designs to leadership and field feedback in real-time, refining and finalizing content in the moment

Contribute to the practice

  • Help evolve Ethos's content standards, tone-of-voice guidelines, and review processes alongside design leadership
  • Support cross-functional partners with writing and content thinking
  • Bring a strong content point of view into conversations with product and design partners, making the case for content as a driver of business outcomes rather than a finishing touch

Use AI to work smarter

  • Use AI tools and frameworks to produce better, more on-brand content faster, sharing what works with the broader team, and without losing the judgment that makes content actually work for customers
  • Help to shape AI tools that can empower others to generate content with the correct tone, structure, and necessary guardrails

Ground the work in evidence

  • Build expertise on Ethos customers and the end-to-end purchase journey through audits, competitive research, and user interviews
  • Test and iterate using analytics, A/B testing, and usability research so data settles disagreements about what's working
  • Stay grounded in what past experiments have already taught the team

Qualifications and Skills:

  • 6+ years of content design or content strategy experience, with a track record of strong independent craft
  • 2+ years on direct-to-consumer digital products, with a portfolio that shows measurable impact on conversion or revenue
  • Strong storytelling instincts, with the ability to find and shape the narrative thread that carries a user through a long, high-consideration journey and defend those choices with more than intuition
  • A command of plain, compelling language that makes complicated or regulated subject matter feel simple and human without oversimplifying it
  • The ability to articulate the single most important message in each moment and craft the content hierarchy and language to land it
  • Presentation skills and the willingness to write collaboratively and in real-time with peers and stakeholders
  • Genuine AI fluency and curiosity, including experience using AI tools to ideate product and screen concepts and structuring prompts to get consistently good writing out of them
  • A collaborative style that builds trust with PMs, designers, and researchers, with a clear point of view that doesn't come at the cost of being easy to work with
  • Comfort in Figma and with regulatory constraints, since in an industry like life insurance, clarity and compliance are the same job

You will be an advocate for user-centered design, design thinking and service design, and passionate about guiding others in content design. Job Title

Contractor Interior Design Content Developer

Job Description

About Us

Kaplan is one of the world’s largest and most diverse education providers. With 80+ years of history, Kaplan has been a beacon for expanding educational access and a leader in instructional innovation.

Role

We are looking for a remote Subject Matter Expert who will assist Kaplan's engineering team in developing material to prepare students for the NCIDQ Interior Design Certification examination. This is a remote opportunity with flexible hours (up to 20 per week).

Responsibilities

The responsibilities of the Contractor may include:

  • Writing quiz questions & practice exam questions in the style of NCIDQ examinations.

  • Writing study materials for any of the three separate NCIDQ exam sections: Fundamentals Exam (IDFX), the Professional Exam (IDPX), and the Practicum Exam (PRAC).

  • Quality assurance reviews, technical reviews, and erratum correction.

  • Contributing to suggested study plans, and providing feedback on customer expectations for study and preparation.

Skill Requirements

The candidate must:

  • Have excellent command of the English language - both verbal and written.

  • Have taken and passed within the last 7 years any section of the exam that they wish to contribute to.

  • Have exceptional attention to detail, organization skills, and time management skills

  • Provide prompt and responsive communication, mostly by email. Occasional video chat meetings during business hours may be required.

  • Be highly motivated and take initiative proactively.

  • Be receptive to feedback, meet deadlines, and take accountability for deliverables.

Preferred Skills

The candidate must:

  • Have experience tutoring/mentoring/educating Interior Design students or colleagues.

  • Have experience creating multiple-choice questions, study materials, PowerPoint presentations or other similar content.

Hours & Employment

This is a contract (1099) position. Projects will be assigned via separate contracts with discrete schedules and deliverables. There is no set working schedule or hours other than project deadlines as assigned.

Equipment Required

Contractors must supply their own equipment and must have installed:

  • Microsoft Word

  • Adobe Reader or Professional

Pay is per project based on contractor availability and experience, typically equivalent to $25-$50 per hour.

Remote/Nationwide, USA

Job Title:

Digital Content Designer (DTC, Amazon & Online Retail)

Job Description

The Digital Content Designer creates high-performing digital content that drives conversion across Direct-to-Consumer (DTC), Amazon, and online retail channels. Working within established brand guidelines and design systems, they produce engaging, customer-focused assets that optimise the online shopping experience and support commercial growth across EMEA markets. The role partners closely with eCommerce, Digital Marketing, Amazon, Sales
and Brand teams to deliver compelling content that is visually engaging, commercially effective
and technically compliant.

Key Responsibilities

Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) Digital Design

  • Design homepage hero banners, promotional graphics, and campaign creative that drive engagement and conversion.
  • Create and maintain landing pages within established website design systems.
  • Develop seasonal campaigns, product launch content, and promotional web experiences.
  • Produce product feature graphics, buying guides, comparison pages, and other conversion-focused website assets.
  • Optimize creative assets for desktop and mobile experiences, ensuring consistency across devices and platforms.

Amazon & Online Retail Partner Content

Create digital assets for online retailer partners including:

  • Create Amazon A+ Content
  • Design Amazon Brand Store pages
  • Produce enhanced product imagery
  • Create feature and benefit graphics
  • Develop lifestyle imagery compositions
  • Retail-specific product graphics
  • Seasonal campaigns

Digital Asset Production & Localization

  • Adapt, resize, and version creative assets across multiple formats and channels.
  • Localize creative for EMEA markets while maintaining brand consistency.
  • Prepare web-optimised imagery.
  • Maintain organized asset libraries.
  • Work within existing design systems, templates, and brand guidelines.
  • Ensure consistency across all channels.

Accessibility & Quality Assurance

  • Apply accessibility best practices, including WCAG and ADA standards.
  • Ensure appropriate color contrast, readability, and inclusive design principles.
  • Create responsive layouts optimized for a variety of devices and screen sizes.
  • Proof and review artwork before publication.
  • Conduct quality assurance checks to ensure accuracy, consistency, and brand compliance.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in digital and eCommerce design.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, Adobe Photoshop, and Adobe Illustrator.
  • Experience creating conversion-focused digital content for eCommerce platforms, marketplaces, or online retailers.
  • Experience creating Amazon A+ Content, Amazon Brand Store pages, and Amazon PDP imagery.
  • Strong understanding of customer journeys, user behavior, and digital best practices.
  • Excellent typography, layout, composition, and visual hierarchy skills.
  • Experience working within design systems and brand guidelines.
  • Experience creating conversion-focused digital content for eCommerce platforms, marketplaces or online retailers
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to maintain high-quality standards.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in English C1 level.
  • Experience with MS Office/Google Workspace.
  • Experience using Digital Asset Management (DAM) platforms.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Familiarity with Asana or similar project management tools.
  • Experience working with Content Management Systems (CMS).
  • Knowledge of accessibility standards and inclusive design practices (WCAG/ADA).
  • Experience supporting international markets
  • Familiarity with AI-powered creative and productivity tools.
  • Experience with Adobe After Effects

What We Offer

At Concentrix, we believe great work starts with great people. We are committed to providing a supportive, flexible, and rewarding environment where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Competitive salary package
  • Remote working model with occasional travel for team collaboration and business meetings (typically one day per month or two days per quarter)
  • Partial reimbursement of travel expenses
  • Standard working schedule (Monday-Friday) with public holidays observed
  • Monthly transportation and internet allowance in addition to base salary
  • Additional bonus for important life events
  • Comprehensive medical and dental healthcare coverage
  • Life and Disability Insurance
  • Multisport Card co-funded by the company
  • Employee discounts on a variety of products and services
  • Five additional paid days annually for educational purposes
